findings.passage: "Look, there's something things I think go too far," said Loudoun County Democrat John McAuliff after voting against a new safe storage law. "We want to make sure we’re not putting additional penalties, additional fees on folks who are otherwise law-abiding, so I voted against it."
findings.note: Quoted by WMRA (Virginia Public Radio) on the day of the House floor votes on a safe-storage bill; he explains his no vote as avoiding added penalties and fees on law-abiding people. The reporter's framing of the quote is included for context.
